flags.reason: The Circular Rating guide (622cd82) and its evidence were checked on 13 October 2026 on v0.1.78-c1fa197 and 17 October on v0.1.78-a116616; CircularRating.tsx and CircularProgressBarDoted.tsx are the same blobs on the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02. Read against the installed source, and rendered with react-native-web 0.21.2 in headless Chromium on 31 October, every sentence this entry quotes still holds, but two evidence sentences do not, and the entry leaves them out: the Contract's Layout line “tier 16 px 700, wrapping with no line clamp” and its slots line “the tier no longer truncates.” (the 12 October #252 re-test says the same). The tier is one line: CircularProgressBarDoted.tsx line 305 passes resolveTruncation(disableTruncation, 1), so numberOfLines 1, and CircularRating never forwards disableTruncation to the ring (lines 217–226). Rendered, a 58-character tier is one 21 px line, 440 px wide, white-space nowrap, overflowing both sides of the 320 px ring. The guide's own Content sentence “Write the tier as a short verdict that fits one line” holds and is kept. Also unclear: Sizing's “A Circular Rating doesn’t resize.” is true of the ring (320 px) and the nudge (312 px), but the root has no width of its own (CircularRating.tsx lines 121–126), so in a wider stretching column the root and its full-width footer row widen while the ring and nudge stay at the left: in a 400 px column the footer row is 380 px wide and its text and icon centre 30 px right of the ring's centre. Re-check these on the installed build and publish the guide and evidence, then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r25, for Marcin to confirm. Guide fix #551; the overflowing tier and the off-centre footer are Component Bug #549.

examples.purpose: Credit health with a next step, the guide's In context: a score of 64 with the tier “Fair”, which the screen picks for that score, a dated footer, and a nudge whose Pay now button is the next step. onTierPress stands for opening the score's breakdown (it makes the tier a button with a chevron), and onPressNudgeButton for opening the card bill.
examples.jsx:
<CircularRating
  value={64}
  label="Credit health"
  tierLabel="Fair"
  footerText="Updated on 8 Oct 2026"
  nudgeBody="Pay your card bill in full to raise your score"
  nudgeButtonLabel="Pay now"
  onTierPress={() => {}}
  onPressNudgeButton={() => {}}
/>

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the whole component.

props.name: value
props.description: NaN is treated as 0. Declared: Rating value. Clamped by CircularProgressBarDoted between 0 and 100. Default 72, from the component source.

props.name: dotCount
props.description: Lit dots are ceil(value / 100 × dotCount), filling clockwise from 12 o'clock: 0 lights none, and any value above 0 lights at least one. Declared: Number of dots rendered around the rating ring. Default 24, from the component source.

props.name: label
props.description: Small label above the score. Default "Rating", from the component source.

props.name: tierLabel
props.description: Text below the score. Default "Doing great", from the component source.

props.name: footerText
props.description: Footer timestamp/copy shown below the rating. Default "Updated on 1 March", from the component source.

props.name: showFooterIcon
props.description: Show the footer info icon. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: showNudge
props.description: Show the bottom inline nudge. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: nudgeBody
props.description: Body text for the default bottom nudge. Default "Split this transaction into installments", from the component source.

props.name: nudgeButtonLabel
props.description: Button label for the default bottom nudge. Default "Button", from the component source.

props.name: onPressNudgeButton
props.description: Called when the nudge button is pressed.

props.name: onTierPress
props.description: Called when the rating tier row is pressed.

props.name: footerSlot
props.description: Replaces the footer text and icon; it receives the rating's modes. Declared: Optional footer slot. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: nudgeSlot
props.description: Replaces the nudge, and shows only with showNudge; it receives the rating's modes. Declared: Optional nudge slot. Receives `modes` recursively.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes forwarded to token lookups and child components.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional container style overrides.

props.name: ratingStyle
props.description: Optional rating ring wrapper style overrides.

props.name: footerStyle
props.description: Optional footer row style overrides.

props.name: footerTextStyle
props.description: Optional footer text style overrides.

props.name: nudgeStyle
props.description: Optional nudge style overrides.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: Reaches only the footer text, not the tier. Declared: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.

gaps.text: Figma draws 26 dots, all lit, on a slightly smaller ring, with a white nudge; the package draws 24 dots lit by the score and colours the nudge with the ring.
At Emphasis Medium and Low the default gold lit dots vanish against the grey track, at 1.00:1 and 1.09:1 (token problem #251, open); at Emphasis High the gold is 1.99:1.
Screen readers hear the label, score and tier twice: in the progress bar's name and again as text.
